cohort.background_sampling: At most 55 non-high-speed tracks per game chosen with fixed seed; all eligible >=7m/s tracks included.
cohort.frame_filter: At least 23 consecutive frames; original 10 Hz NFL pre-pass tracking only.

sky_masks.partial_canopy: Open mask, excluding two opposite azimuth sectors centered at 90 and 270 deg relative to a randomized roof orientation, half-width 25 deg, below 40 deg elevation
sky_masks.deep_canopy: Open mask, excluding sectors with half-width 45 deg, below 50 deg elevation
sky_masks.sealed_roof: All direct GPS line-of-sight signals blocked; 0 satellites

roof_orientation: Uniform in [0,180) degrees, fixed within each player track; shared across all scenarios for given seed/track

signal_modes.measured_proxy: Leave-one-out Pixel Watch residual proxy bootstrap with AR(1) phi=0.5; no faults
signal_modes.degraded_sensitivity: Same random proxy draws x2 plus common persistent 5% satellite faults of 5-10 m/s amplitude

receiver: GPS-only 7-9 satellite observation templates from real Pixel Watch in an unrelated location and time; hypothetical stadium geometries
sampling: 1 Hz randomly phased with 10-Hz NFL reference, held-out five NFL games
processing: >=6 satellites, <=4 m/s formal 3D velocity sigma, <=15 m/s solution speed; FDE z=5, robust Huber=3.5
science_limit: No roof geometry, RF propagation, live NFL GPS receivers, real stadium GNSS measurements, or measured sprinting GNSS data.
